description: This file defines the UserRepository interface for accessing UserEntity data in a SQL database, including custom query methods for user retrieval and counting, as well as external dependencies on Spring Data JPA and related classes.

classes.name: UserRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for UserEntity with custom query methods for user data retrieval and counting.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndEmail
methods.description: Finds a user by tenant ID and email.

methods.name: findUsersByAuthority
methods.description: Finds users by tenant ID, customer ID, authority, with optional search text, paginated.

methods.name: findTenantAndCustomerUsers
methods.description: Finds users by tenant ID, multiple customer IDs, with optional search text, paginated.

methods.name: findByTenantId
methods.description: Finds users by tenant ID with optional search text, paginated.

methods.name: findAllByAuthority
methods.description: Finds all users with a specific authority, paginated.

methods.name: findByAuthorityAndTenantIdIn
methods.description: Finds users by authority and a collection of tenant IDs, paginated.

methods.name: findByAuthorityAndTenantProfilesIds
methods.description: Finds users by authority and tenant profile IDs, paginated.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of UserFields starting after a given user ID.

methods.name: countByTenantIdAndAuthority
methods.description: Counts users by tenant ID and authority.

methods.name: findUserAuthDetailsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves user authentication details and enabled status by user ID.

methods.name: findUsersByTenantIdAndIdIn
methods.description: Finds users by tenant ID and a list of user IDs.
